name: Photon geocoder public instance (photon.komoot.io)
tier_rationale: Identifiable company operating an open-source (Apache-2.0) geocoder over OSM data with public documentation since 2014; fair-use public instance without a service-level commitment (A8 community; P262 cond 2: 'komoot community').

reliability.justification: Same OSM data as Nominatim through a search-as-you-type index: global free-text matching, so homonymous streets abroad are filtered to the seed's country; precision comes from the matched object type.

geocoding.title: Photon /api (forward) and /reverse geocoding - GeoJSON FeatureCollection, coordinates [lon, lat]

terms.quote: Data: ODbL (OSM data); Photon Apache-2.0 (self-hostable). Fair use, no hard published limit (no bulk). [research C0602; P262 cond 2: 'Photon (photon.komoot.io, returns [lon, lat]) is the only fallback']

geocoding.notes: Batch p3-G12-1 (P262 geocoding): the only fallback of Nominatim (used when Nominatim is SKIPPED config, BLOCKED, RATE_LIMITED or ERROR, or found nothing). Live 2026-11-26: /api and /reverse 200 in 0.5-0.7 s (cache-control max-age=3600, no rate-limit headers), a random token gives {'features': []}, lat=999 gives HTTP 400 {'lat': [{'message': ...}]}. Search is global: results are kept only in the seed's country (BR).

notes: Owned by batch p3-G12-1 (P262). Self-limited to 1 req/s (fair use; published: false = V3LUM's own budget, not a provider figure).
